text.en: Cat owners express complete confidence in sitter Libby, praising her professional reliability and friendly demeanor. Reviewers note that she is easy to get along with and treats client homes and pets with great respect. Repeat customers emphasize that having a dependable sitter provides immense peace of mind while away.

Client feedback highlights the calm, affectionate handling provided to cats during home visits. Pet parents of indoor-only or anxious felines report that their companions quickly bonded with Libby and remained relaxed throughout the booking. Owners consistently return home to contented, well-fed, and settled pets.

A standout theme across reviews is the frequency and quality of communication during pet sitting visits. Owners appreciate receiving photos, videos, and detailed messages after every visit, allowing them to verify their cats' wellbeing in real time. Reviewers describe this regular contact as deeply reassuring.

q.en: Does Happy Cat provide in-home cat sitting visits?

a.en: Yes, Libby provides home visiting services to feed, care for, and keep company with cats while owners are away.

q.en: Will I receive updates while I am travelling?

a.en: Yes, clients consistently report receiving photos, videos, and status messages after every scheduled visit.

q.en: Can multiple cats in the same household be looked after?

a.en: Yes, reviewers confirm that multi-cat households with two or three cats are comfortably accommodated.
